# `armadad etcd`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armadad.md)

etcd runs this server's etcd member with the etcd program of the runtime pack
instead of inside `armadad server` (ADR 0055). It works the member out as the
server does (name, data, addresses, certificate), writes etcd's configuration
file (etcd/etcd.yaml, 0600) beside it, and replaces itself with etcd.
Before etcd first runs on a member the server ran, it copies the member's data
to etcd/data.before-unit once. It refuses while another process holds the
member. For now only lab machines run it, with `armadad server --etcd-member unit`.
Flags it does not know (the server's, from ARMADA_SERVER_FLAGS) are ignored.

```
armadad etcd [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
sudo systemctl status armada-etcd                 # started by systemd on lab servers (ADR 0055)
sudo armadad etcd --bin-dir /opt/etcd-v3.7.4       # a build without the runtime pack
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--bin-dir string` | use the etcd program in this directory (builds without the runtime pack) |
| `--data-dir string` | Armada data directory (default `/var/lib/armada`) |
